checks.title: What V1 and V1b test (relabelled: frictionless homogeneous-field test)
checks.detail: V1 is not a patch test in the strict finite-element sense and not evidence about friction or contact. With zero friction the exact solution is a homogeneous field that lies in the P2/P1 space, so V1 only shows that the discretisation reproduces an exact homogeneous solution, and that assembly, the power-balance force and the time loop are consistent for it. It would pass with a wrong friction law or wrong contact handling. The friction physics is covered only by V3 (trend), V4/V4b (convergence) and V5/V5b (sticking bound).
